subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 10: Get ready for A1 Movers
outcomes: Say which picture is different and explain why.
Read the text and all the options carefully before choosing.
Answer personal questions with full sentences and extra information.

tf.s: In Reading and Writing Part 3, read the whole text and all the options before you choose.
tf.why: Reading everything first helps you choose the right word.

tf.s: In Listening Part 3, you will need all the pictures.
tf.why: You won't need all the pictures, so check each one carefully.

tf.s: In the exam, the answers are often very similar, so read each one carefully.
tf.why: Similar answers can trick you, so read slowly.

tf.s: To explain your choice, you can say: This picture is different because …
tf.why: This sentence helps you give a reason.

tf.s: "Yes, I painted a picture." is a good answer to "Did you make a rocket?"
tf.why: The answer must be about the rocket, for example: Yes, but I didn't finish it.

tf.s: When you tell a story from pictures, you can use first, then, next and finally.
tf.why: These words put the story in order.

tf.s: In Speaking Part 4, one word like "Yes" is the best answer.
tf.why: Give a full sentence and add extra information.

tf.s: You need electricity to write a letter.
tf.why: You don't need electricity to write a letter. That is why it is different from a computer.

tf.s: "No, I couldn't. My mum tied them for me." is a good answer to "Could you tie your shoelaces when you were four?"
tf.why: It answers the question and adds extra information.

tf.s: We use "which" for people, for example: Juma is the boy which will buy a phone case.
tf.why: We use "who" for people: Juma is the boy who will buy a phone case.

boxes.q: Complete: I use my computer to send ______.
boxes.why: We send emails on a computer.

boxes.q: Complete: I want to win a ______.
Complete: Sometimes I listen to ______ on my computer.
boxes.why: You can listen to music on a computer.

boxes.q: Complete: Sultan wants to go to the shop ______ sells necklaces.
boxes.why: We use "which" for things, like a shop.

boxes.q: Complete: The greengrocer's ______ bananas and other fruit.
boxes.why: The greengrocer's is one shop, so we say "sells".

boxes.q: Malik brings the bag. What is the best answer?
boxes.why: Malik helped, so we thank him.

boxes.q: Did you write any letters last month?
o: No, I didn't, but I sent some emails.
boxes.why: A past question needs a past answer: I didn't / I sent.

boxes.q: Which word do we use at the end of a story?
boxes.why: "Finally" tells us it is the last part.

boxes.q: Complete: Juma, Sultan and Sabah ______ go to the shops to buy their grandma a present.
boxes.why: With three people we say "have to".

boxes.q: How many times do you usually hear the audio in a listening task?
boxes.why: You hear it twice, so you can check your answers.

hunt.q: Odd one out: computer, tablet, phone, letter
First word to start a story

mcq.q: What is the exam tip for Reading and Writing Part 3?
o: Read the text and all the options before choosing.
Choose the first word you see.
Write the words before you read.
mcq.why: Reading everything first helps you choose well.

mcq.q: Which sentence do we use in Speaking Part 3?
mcq.why: We say which picture is different and give a reason.

mcq.q: Which words help you tell a story from pictures?
mcq.why: These words show the order of the story.

mcq.q: How should you answer the questions in Speaking Part 4?
o: With full sentences and extra information
mcq.why: Full answers show what you can say.

mcq.q: Malik: Will you go to Space Club this afternoon? Choose the best answer.
o: No, I don't think I'll go today. I've got a lot of homework.
Yes, I went there last week.
mcq.why: The question is about the future, so the answer uses will (I'll).

mcq.q: Did you make a rocket last week at Space Club? Choose the best answer.
o: Yes, but I didn't finish it.
mcq.why: Only this answer talks about the rocket in the past.

mcq.q: Choose the words: Juma is the boy ___ will buy a phone case. Sultan wants the shop ___ sells necklaces.
mcq.why: "Who" is for people and "which" is for things.

mcq.q: Computer, tablet, mobile phone, letter. Why is the letter different?
o: You don't need electricity to write it.
You can play games on it.
mcq.why: The other three need electricity, but a letter doesn't.

mcq.q: Why is it important to check every picture in Listening Part 3?
o: You won't need all the pictures, and some are very similar.
All the pictures are the same.
mcq.why: Some pictures are not answers, so check carefully.

mcq.q: Could you tie your shoelaces when you were four? Which is the best Speaking Part 4 answer?
o: No, I couldn't. My mum tied them for me.
mcq.why: It uses the past and adds extra information.
